name: viber-brawl-multiplayer
description: Cloudflare-native real-time multiplayer for Viber Brawl (Worker + Durable Objects + WebSockets)

scripts.db:tables: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf%' AND name NOT LIKE 'd1_%' ORDER BY name"
